quickAdd.hint: Separate with commas or spaces. 1-20 is a range and 45x2 is two copies. Other rarities use their short name and number: SCR12 is card 12’s Secret Rare, and ranges work too (QCSR1-QCSR20). Special prints add their own letters: UREA1 is card 1’s Extended Art Ultra Rare.
quickAdd.empty: Cards run from MAMS-EN001 to MAMS-EN125.

help.tiers: Standard, Master or Grand Master: pick what you’re collecting above the cards. Standard is the 125 cards, each in its main rarity. Master adds the 124 other rarities. Grand Master adds the serial-numbered Grand Master Rares. Cards you’ve marked are kept when you switch.

about.title: About the Magnificent Maestros set
paragraphs: Magnificent Maestros is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG special set released on 12 November 2026, in the SEVENS & GO RUSH!! era. It has 125 cards, and with the 142 other rarities there are 267 to collect in all.

Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 125 cards, each in its main rarity), the Master set (249, adding the 124 other rarities) or the Grand Master set (all 267, adding the serial-numbered Grand Master Rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
